name: secret-guard
description: Stops before Claude writes API keys, tokens, private keys or a non-ignored .env into files, git add or commits. Exceptions for test keys and example files: /secret-allow.

mode.title: Secret Guard: mode
mode.description: block: refuse the action. warn: only warn and let it through.

placeholders.title: Secret Guard: let placeholders pass
placeholders.description: on: values with EXAMPLE, DUMMY, FAKE, PLACEHOLDER, REDACTED, SAMPLE, xxxxxx … are no secret (this covers the AWS documentation keys).

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the texts this mod shows and writes.
